description.html: This water dish has a wide, flat bottom and a low raised rim in terracotta color. The shape is rounded, a little like a droplet, and the lighter shades along the rim resemble natural stone faded by the sun.

Its biggest advantage is a shallow depth combined with a large surface. Young lizards, leopard geckos and baby tortoises can easily walk up to the water and climb back out, with no risk of slipping into deep water. The wide surface also means your animal notices the water sooner, which helps with individuals that are just learning to drink from a dish.

Shallow water evaporates faster and warms up quickly if the dish sits near a heat lamp. Place it on the cooler side of the terrarium and top it up as needed. Replace the water with fresh water every day, because substrate and droppings collect quickly in shallow water. Press the dish slightly into the substrate or set it directly on the floor so it sits level and does not move when your animal steps on the rim.
